plugin.name: Splinter Cell: Double Agent (Cxbx-Reloaded) Widescreen Fix
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Language of the settings descriptions. Auto follows the system language.
MAIN.FixHUD.description: Keeps the HUD at its original shape instead of stretching it with the emulator window.
MAIN.HudAspectRatioConstraint.descriptio: Auto follows the emulator window. Enter width:height (for example 16:9) or a decimal value to set the HUD shape yourself. This does not change the game camera or the emulator's display mode.
